title: B001: Common Types & Pure Function Packages
description:
**Size:** 🏗️ large
**Category:** backend
**Priority:** high

## Resolved Decisions

| # | Decision | Choice |
|---|----------|--------|
| 1 | `PipelinePosition` model | Struct with `Before` and `After` fields — `type PipelinePosition struct { Before string; After string }` |
| 2 | `RenderPastePipeline` input | `PipelineSpec` struct — `{ Name, BasePipeline, Filters []FilterSpec, Middleware []MiddlewareSpec }` |
| 3 | `ValidatePolicyRules` return | `field.ErrorList` — webhook-compatible from day one, avoids CC-0011 breaking change |
| 4 | Kubebuilder markers | No markers on shared types — markers belong on CRD embedding sites in CC-0011 |

## Summary

CC-0004 implements the foundational shared type definitions and pure-function utility packages under `internal/common/`. This includes 11 reusable Go types (`ImageSpec`, `DatabaseSpec`, `MessagingSpec`, `CacheSpec`, `SecretRefSpec`, `PolicySpec`, `PluginSpec`, `MiddlewareSpec`, `PipelinePosition`, `PipelineSpec`, `FilterSpec`) and 4 utility packages (`conditions/`, `config/`, `plugins/`, `policy/`) containing pure functions that operate on Go maps, slices, and structs with no Kubernetes client interaction. All functions get table-driven unit tests using `gomega` + `testing.T` following existing codebase conventions.

## Scope

**Included:**
- `internal/common/types/` — 11 shared type structs with JSON tags and godoc (9 original + `PipelineSpec` + `FilterSpec`)
- `internal/common/conditions/` — `SetCondition`, `IsReady`, `GetCondition`, `AllTrue` operating on `[]metav1.Condition`
- `internal/common/config/` — `RenderINI`, `MergeDefaults`, `InjectSecrets`, `InjectOsloPolicyConfig` operating on `map[string]map[string]string`
- `internal/common/plugins/` — `RenderPastePipeline`, `RenderPluginConfig` producing INI text
- `internal/common/policy/` — `RenderPolicyYAML`, `MergePolicies`, `ValidatePolicyRules` (returns `field.ErrorList`)
- Table-driven unit tests for every exported function (`gomega` + `testing.T`, no build tags)

**Excluded (with rationale):**
- `CreateImmutableConfigMap` — requires K8s client, belongs in CC-0005
- `LoadPolicyFromConfigMap` — requires K8s client, belongs in CC-0005
- Kubebuilder CEL markers on types — belongs in CC-0011 (CRD embedding sites)
- Webhook validation logic — belongs in CC-0011
- `database/`, `deployment/`, `job/`, `secrets/`, `tls/` packages — all require K8s client, CC-0005
- OpenStack release-specific default values — belong in operator-level code (YAGNI)

## Key Components

- **`types/`** — 11 shared structs. `DatabaseSpec`, `MessagingSpec`, `CacheSpec` follow managed/brownfield dual-mode with `ClusterRef` vs explicit host fields. `SecretRefSpec` is embedded in multiple specs. `PipelinePosition` has `Before`/`After` string fields. `PipelineSpec` aggregates `BasePipeline`, `[]FilterSpec`, and `[]MiddlewareSpec`. `FilterSpec` captures base filter name, factory, and config.
- **`conditions/`** — 4 pure functions for `metav1.Condition` slice manipulation. `AllTrue` gates the aggregate `Ready` condition in reconcilers. Zero K8s client dependency.
- **`config/`** — INI rendering pipeline. `RenderINI` sorts sections/keys deterministically for stable content hashes. `MergeDefaults` implements user-wins-over-operator-defaults precedence. `InjectSecrets` assembles connection strings. `InjectOsloPolicyConfig` conditionally adds `[oslo_policy]` section.
- **`plugins/`** — `RenderPastePipeline` takes `PipelineSpec`, inserts middleware filters at specified `PipelinePosition`s, and emits `[filter:]` blocks as api-paste.ini text. `RenderPluginConfig` converts `[]PluginSpec` into INI section maps for merging into main config.
- **`policy/`** — `MergePolicies` implements inline-wins-over-external precedence. `RenderPolicyYAML` serializes merged rules as YAML. `ValidatePolicyRules` returns `field.ErrorList` for webhook-compatible validation (non-empty keys/values, valid YAML syntax).
